sample_unit: LLM responses to guideline-based questions (75 per model)

links.outcome: Expert panel agreement with LLM answers to guideline-based urologic oncology questions
links.effect: Consensus in agreement overall: Claude 59/75 (78.7%), Gemini 75/75 (100%), ChatGPT 72/75 (96%) (p<0.001); Claude UTUC 56%.
links.quote: Across all questions, consensus in agreement was achieved for 59/75 Claude responses (78.7%), 75/75 Gemini responses (100%), and 72/75 ChatGPT responses (96%) (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the performance/accuracy of three LLMs answering guideline-based bladder cancer questions using a multidisciplinary Delphi panel of expert clinicians.
